content: Israel runagunata Dios japishcamanda
Ñáuca Cristohua runa asha sirtumi rimani mana llullanichu, Diospa Samai yuyachihuan ñuca sirtuta rimangaraushcata.
Ñáuca shungu ucui israelgunamanda yapa llaquirishami nanarishcacuinta puriuni.
Ñáuca ailluguna acpi paigunata yapa llaquishcamandami paiguna quishpichishca tucunauchun nisha ñuca randiga Cristomanda anchuchishca tucunata munaimami.

Israelgunaga Dios japishca runagunami aunguna paihua churiguna tucungahua, paigunahuan causangahua. Paigunatami Dios paihua quiquin sumacta ricuchisha cuirashca. Paiguna huañuc apayayagunata pai pactachishami niushca shimigunata chariunguna, chasnallata pai mandashcagunatas paigunama cushcami. Paita alabangahua paigunatami yachachishca. Dios paigunahuacpi rangarauni nisha rimashcata charinaun.

Paigunaga ñaupa apayayagunamanda miraiguna maunguna. Dios cachashca quishpichic Cristoga paigunamanda mirai asha israel runa mara. Chasna runa tucushallata paiga tucuita mandac Dios man, paitaga huiñai balichishca tucuchun. Chasna achun.
Mana tucuiguna quiricchanaun
Ashca israelguna mana uyagllaita Diospa Shimiga mana pishiyanzhu. Tucui israelmanda miraigunaga mana Diospa runaguna chanaun.

Mana tucui israel nishca runagunaga ñucanchi huañuc apayaya Abrahanmanda miraiguna chanaura. Astahuanbas yachanguichi Dios Abrahanda casna nishca: Camba churi Isaacmanda miraigunallami israel nishca runa tucungauna.
Diospa runagunaga mana aichamandallachu aunguna astahuan pai rimashca shimimandami sirtu Diospa runaguna tucushcauna.
Chimanda Dios rangaraushca shimita Abrahanda casna cuintashcami: Ñáuca rimashca uraspi camba huarmi Saraga shuc huahuata charingami, cari huahuata.
Chi churiga ñucanchi huañuc apayaya Isaac nishcaga huiñashami Rebeca nishca huarmita japira. Huasha chi huarmiga ishcai (2) cari huahuata huicsayara.

Paiguna huicsa ucui tiyaushcallaita alitas mana alitas chara mana rashcallaita Dios paigunamanda rimashca. Chimanda rimasha ricuchin mana runa rashcamandachu, astahuanbas Dios ñaupamandapacha munasha japishcata ricuchinmi.
Paigunamanda Rebecata rimashca: Punda churiga quipata uyac tucungami.
Chasnallata Diospa shimibi paigunamanda casna quillcashcami: Quipa churi Jacobota llaquishcani, punda churi Esaúta mana llaquishcanichu nisha.
Yaya Dios piñashcamandas llaquishcamandahuas
Chasna tucushcamanda imasata rimashun. Dios shucta yali llaquishaga mana alitachu rashca nishachu rimashun. Mana.
Ñáaupa uras huañuc Moisesta Dios casna nishca:

content.text: Maican runatas ñuca llaquinata munashaga llaquishami,

content: Chasna acpi ñucanchi Diospa runa tucunata mana runa munashcamandachu, mana mandashcagunata pactachishcamandachu, astahuanbas Dios yuyarisha yanapashcamandallami paihua runa tucunata ushanchi.
Chimanda Diospa shimibi casna quillcashcami Faraonma rimasha:

content.text: Tucui llactaibi tiyaccuna ñuca canda ushaihuan turmintachishcata uyangahua,
tucuiguna ñuca sirtu jatun ushayuc ashcata yachangahua,

content: Chasna asha Dios maican runata yuyarisha yanapanata munashaga yanapanmi. Maican runata mana ali shunguta ranata munashaga mana alitachu ran.
Chita yuyarisha maican rimahuanguichima: Dios imata ranata munacpiga mana pihuas jarcanata ushanzhu. Chasna acpiga imahuacta Dios ñucanchita caudsayachihuan nisha rimahuanguichima.
Ama chasna rimaichichu. Canga runa ashcamanda ushac Diosta chasna rimanata imasata ushanguima. Allpa mangaga paita ahuac huarmita imahuata casna ricurictaga ahuahuarangui nisha rimangachu. Mana.
Chi mangata ahuac huarmiga allpata japisha ishcai (2) mangata ahuasha, shucta ali mangata, shuctaga pugllana mangahuahuata ahuasha pai munashcata ran.

Chi pugllana mangaga mana balic ashami huasha jichushca tucunga. Dios chasnallata rashcami. Runaguna juchata rashcamandami pai piñashcatas paihua ushaitas ricuchingahua chara mana jichushallata astahuan ahuantasha chapaurami chi juchamanda jichuitucuc runagunata huasha chingachingahua.
Ñáucanchiga pai shuc ali rashca mangacuinta anchi pai sumac acta huasha japingahua. Chasna rashami pai llaquishca runagunama pai yapa sumac auta ricuchingahuaca ñaupata munasha ñucanchita japishcami.
Yaya Dios ñucanchita japishcami maicanguna israel runa acpihuas mana-israel runa acpihuas.
Ñáaupa uras Oseas nishca Dios rimashcata pasachic runama chasna japishcamandami nira casna:
Israelgunamanda rimasha ñaupa uras Dios rimashcata pasachic Isaiaspas casnami nishca:

content.text: Israel runaguna mana yupaibac tiyucuinta mirarishallata
Jatun Diosca tucui cai munduibi tiyac runagunata
taripashami nisha rimashcacuinta mana unayasha sirtu pactachingami.

content: Chasna nisha Isaias rimashcami.
Taripanamandas pai chasnallata rimara casna:

content.text: Tucuita mandauc jatun Dios libachishallata mana huindachu tucuchishca.
Gomorra llactagunata piñasha libachishcacuinta illacta tucunchinmara, nishami rimashca.

content: Mictiasha urmashcashinamanda
Chasna acpiga imatata rimashunchi. Casna. Maican mana-israel runagunaga Diospacpi ali tucunata mana yuyarishcaibis cunanga Cristota quirishcamandami Diospacpi ali tucushcauna.
Astahuanbas israelgunaga chi mandashcagunata pactachishcamanda Diospacpi ali tucushun nisha purigllaita mana paihuacpi chasna ali tucushcachanaura.

Imamandata paiguna Diospacpi ali tucunata mana ushanaura. Cristota mana quirisha, ñucanchi quiquin rashcallahuan Diospacpi ali tucusha nishcamandami mana ushanaura. Paiguna chasna pandasha shuc rumibi mictiashcacuinta tucushcauna.
Jesucristo chi mictiana rumicuinta acpi Diospa shimibi casna quillcashcami tiyan:

content.text: Uyaichi. Sion nishca israel llactaibi shuc rumita churani.
Astahuanbas paita quiric runaga mana urmasha mana pingaringachu ninmi.
